answer: Make the recruiter liable. Attestation weight follows verified work, and when a recruited identity is caught faking, the weight it lent is burned along with the recruiter's. Auditors rotate so nobody grades their own tree. Concretely: one bad recruit costs the recruiter the standing of two good epochs, which makes volume recruiting a liability instead of an asset. A whisper of doubt on one identity travels up the thread to whoever vouched for it, and the prism of borrowed trust bends the cost back onto the sponsor.
